messages.text: Where can I see the messages people sent with this form?

Wix Forms submissions aren't stored in this codebase — they go to your Wix dashboard. Open the site in Wix and check **Dashboard → Customer Management → Inbox**, or **Marketing & SEO → Forms → Submissions**, to see the messages sent through this form.
